problem: Generic wording that regulators blocked the deal can overstate procedural posture
evidence_or_reason: Parties publicly said there was no clear path to required regulatory approvals and mutually terminated; CMA findings were provisional

problem: Figma later IPO does not by itself prove the $1B fee caused IPO success
evidence_or_reason: Chronology is documented but causation requires separate evidence

problem: CMA published provisional findings and possible remedies but no final prohibition because parties abandoned transaction

problem: Figma later IPO is tempting to attribute to termination fee
